SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", s.stock_code AS "code", a.quantity AS "shares", a.purchase_amount AS "buyPrice", a.avg_price AS "avgBuyPrice",
70000 AS "currentPrice",
(70000 * a.quantity) AS "totalValue", ((70000 * a.quantity) - a.purchase_amount) AS "profit", CASE WHEN a.purchase_amount > 0 THEN ROUND(((70000 * a.quantity) - a.purchase_amount) / a.purchase_amount * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS "profitRate" FROM asset a JOIN stock s ON a.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY (70000 * a.quantity) DESC
